m01:room.title: The Storage Survey Gallery
m01:room.job: Decide what to do with one strange point in last night's lake trace.

m02:room.title: The Catchment Instrument House
m02:room.job: Build an alarm that reacts to how fast the lake is rising and not only to how high it is.

m03:room.title: The Gate Calibration Bay
m03:room.job: Work out how far the gate arm must swing back to cut the flow by 6 cubic metres per second.

m04:room.title: The Valley Warning Office
m04:room.job: Work out the latest minute the school road closure can be called.

m05:room.title: The Power Dispatch Hall
m05:room.job: Find the highest power the old ramp plan reaches anywhere in its run.

m06:room.title: The Forecast Archive
m06:room.job: Decide which of two storm forecasts goes into the plan.

m07:room.title: The Water Ledger Room
m07:room.job: Add up the rain inflow to a total, and find how much water must leave the lake before it arrives.

m08:room.title: The Turbine Passage
m08:room.job: Check whether an eight-hour gate release removes enough water, with the turbine and snowmelt counted.

m09:room.title: The Uplift Gallery
m09:room.job: Decide whether two silent gauges mean rising uplift or a shared cable fault.

m10:room.title: The Drainage Control Room
m10:room.job: Find the first hour when the next gate step can go ahead under the seepage limit.

m11:room.title: The Reservoir Survey Archive
m11:room.job: Find how much storm room the silt has taken.

m12:room.title: The Machine Hall
m12:room.job: Find the room the surge shaft has for a trip at full flow.

m13:room.title: The Independent Review Gallery
m13:room.job: Price the level error, and test whether the recorder's rate channel can be trusted.

m14:room.title: The Emergency Communications Hall
m14:room.job: Find the fastest route to the siren that stayed dark.

m15:room.title: The Release Command Gallery
m15:room.job: Pick the release plan that clears the corrected target inside every limit.
